decision: Retain the source-labeled POMx extract as an original-abstract-depth functional research reserve; no clinical lead or nomination displacement.

identity_boundary.unverified: Exact dose, standardization, full composition, carrier, supplier, batch and current retail equivalence.
identity_boundary.component_attribution: Abstract title/rationale concern ellagitannins, but isolated-component efficacy is not demonstrated.

studies.formulation_details: Extract, not interchangeable with generic juice. Exact composition, quantity, carrier, supplier and batch unverified from abstract.
studies.design: Randomized crossover with placebo, each treatment for 9 days
studies.challenge: Two sets of 20 maximal eccentric elbow-flexion exercises with one arm.
studies.strength_scale: Percentage of baseline, not absolute-force contrast
studies.retained_limits: Abstract reports similar early reduction (about 72% of baseline) with both treatments and incomplete recovery at 96 hours (about 91%). No exact 24/96-hour pairwise tests or clinically durable strength benefit supplied.
studies.soreness: Measured but no quantified result in original abstract.
studies.biomarkers: CK, myoglobin, IL-6 and CRP measured; abstract says they did not illuminate the mechanism. Marker-specific tests/nulls not reconstructed.

citation.title: Ellagitannin consumption improves strength recovery 2-3 d after eccentric exercise

studies.role: Positive original-abstract preparation evidence, not a complete-main appraisal
method_gaps: Exact extract dose, ingredient standardization and vehicle
Sequence generation, concealment and detailed masking
Washout, contralateral-arm assignment, repeated-bout and carryover analyses
Primary endpoint hierarchy, trial registration, multiplicity and analytical model
Specific soreness/biomarker nulls and safety/tolerability counts
BUB1B/BUBR1 or MVA outcomes in full text
studies.safety: No adverse-event counts or tolerability results supplied by original abstract; do not infer absence of harms.
studies.funding: Original abstract does not identify sponsor/funding/conflicts. PubMed Research Support, Non-U.S. Govt indexing does not identify a sponsor or financial role.

studies.role: Distinct preparation counterevidence from the already full-qualified 2019 cohort; not a new biological cohort or POMx replication.
studies.preparation: POM Wonderful undiluted pomegranate juice; not verified equivalent to POMx extract.
studies.interpretation: No detectable recovery benefit in its three-arm analysis; not an equivalence test or exact-product refutation of POMx. All original methods, missingness, native outcomes, chemical-assay dispersion limits and other reporting limitations are retained in the separately linked cherry qualification.

interpretation.direct_functional_credit: Original abstract reports POMx–placebo differences in measured maximal isometric strength at 48 and 72 hours after eccentric exercise. Compensation-oriented useful-function credit does not require a BUBR1 assay.
interpretation.scale: Percent of reported baseline; arithmetic differences of 7.1 and 4.9 percentage points are not absolute force, relative percentage improvements or treatment-effect CIs.
interpretation.statistics: Reported P=.01 and .009; dispersion type, model, paired implementation and multiplicity handling unknown. Do not relabel tests corrected or uncorrected.
interpretation.other_results: Similar early reduction and incomplete late recovery are descriptions, not formal equivalence/pairwise null tests. Soreness unquantified; mechanistically uninformative serum-marker wording is not a null for every marker.
secondary_imports_excluded: exact dose reconstructed from Lamb, reviews or manufacturer material
interpretation.cross_study: No pooling, shared aliases, dose-response mechanism or potency comparison with the distinct 2019 juice.
interpretation.source_depth_standard: Full-text inaccessibility is not a unique disqualifier for a narrow reported abstract finding. Apply source-depth limits consistently to inherited and new evidence; equal eligibility does not imply equal evidence strength.

competitiveness.retained: Preparation-specific controlled acute strength-recovery signal at original-abstract depth.
competitiveness.nominee_effect: Niacin and apitegromab are not displaced or re-ranked; neither has demonstrated MVA rescue. This gap is not applied only to challengers.
competitiveness.advancement: Stronger transfer requires identifiable preparation/exposure and useful affected-model output with preserved renewable reserve and chromosome fidelity. BUBR1 mediation is additionally required only for restoration claims.
